task_reconciliation.task: Scoped prefab/rendering/visor Volume route removed. Project-wide scene/URP/UI Volume residue remains outside SHINOBU_235 scope and is reported as out-of-domain residue.
Active Noir route binds one CBuffer; scoped string setter scan reports zero Material.Set*(string) and Shader.SetGlobal*(string) hits.
Noir hot DTOs use explicit raw public fields; no hot mutable properties were introduced.
Primary Noir DTOs are explicit 64-byte structs with 16-byte float4 lanes.
Burst mock input writer fills the same Vault input DTO when owner snapshots are absent.
`CalculateNoirParametersJob` is Burst Fast/Standard and uses NoAlias raw pointers from Vault NativeArray views.
Glitch is a shader-side block/triangle/hash fake, not CPU physics or particles.
Fitted ACES is in `Hecton_VisorGlitchACES.shader`; URP Volume ACES is bypassed for the active Noir route.
Constants use double GraphicsBuffer CBuffers and dirty-only LockBufferForWrite/MemCpy upload.
GlobalQualityWeight drives continuous curves for grain, chroma, glitch, cadence, and profile lookup; no binary hardware tier switch.
Noir uses one RenderGraph raster pass, imports the constant buffer, declares UseBuffer(Read), reads source color, and writes camera color.
CPU writes wrapped 0..1000 time into CBuffer; shader scan reports `_Time=0`.
Noir input is presentation-only and documented outside save/rollback authority.
Cold scratch buffers use UninitializedMemory where deterministic zero is not required; telemetry/profile rings are bounded.
300-entry Noir telemetry ring and NaN dump path to `Docs/AgentLogs/Dump_SHINOBU_235.bin` exist.
Editor tuner exists and updates managed labels only on quantized display change.
CSV bridge uses cold byte-cursor parsing into Vault arrays. NativeHashMap was rejected because current IDataVault exposes NativeArray-style ownership only.
A/B split is a CBuffer scalar consumed branchlessly in shader.
`Volume_Component_Inquisition` writes `Docs/Reports/RENDERING_OPTIMIZATION_REPORT.json` and preserves scoped proof fields.
This file, Status, Rationale, LOG, route card, ledger, and JSON report carry the proof. Unity import/profiler proof remains pending.

SELF_AUDIT.scalability_curve: Below quality 0.3, highDetail01 smoothly trends to zero, chroma/glitch offsets collapse through polynomial masks, profile lookup cadence stretches toward 18 frames, and the shader keeps one camera sample with cheap hash grain plus ACES/tint/vignette. Mid quality ramps masks without variants. Ultra quality spends more ALU on visible grain/glitch/chroma intensity through the same CBuffer layout.

dependency_graph.consume: Phase-local GlobalDataVault NativeArray views for input, tuning, constants, telemetry, and profiles.

SELF_AUDIT.compile_guard: Noir partial carries no `Hecton8.Physics`, `HectonFluidEngine`, `HectonSurvivalSystem`, or `HectonPlayerMovement` references. Legacy non-Noir visor code still has pre-existing Gameplay/Physics references outside the active SHINOBU route.
SELF_AUDIT.dear_lie: Stress/depth visuals are optical shader fakes: fitted ACES, one-hash grain, block/triangle glitch, and channel-phase chroma from one source sample. Rejected physical fog, particles, deformation, and multi-tap chromatic aberration. Complexity moved from CPU/object simulation O(n objects or particles) to O(pixels) single fullscreen shader pass with one texture sample.
